copy.tagline: 锁定高清画布，自由组合组件制作幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在固定画布上自由设计演示内容
copy.tagline_en: Lock canvas at 1920x1080 and compose slides with React components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design presentations with free-form component layout on a fixed canvas

howto.what: 做幻灯片时，Claude 会把每页锁在 1920×1080 画布上，不套模板，按内容性质自由排布，产出一份单文件 HTML、只用你真实内容的 deck。
howto.when: 当你想做不被模板束缚的 deck 时触发，比如个人作品集、艺术或设计课的演示。

howto.what_en: For slides, Claude locks each page to a 1920×1080 canvas and lays every slide out freely by content, with no template, producing a single-file HTML deck built from your real content.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a deck that is not bound to a template, such as a personal portfolio or an art / design class deck.
